name: [PRE ALPHA] Arcane Seas
desc:
❗Welcome to Arcane Seas! A passion project.

Explore the seas and dungeons, Uncover dangerous bosses and factions, Gather your crew and legendary magics then pick between good and evil. Hidden items all over the sea.❓
✨New code at 10K likes!✨

Controls:
X2 Space - Double Jump
X2 W - Sprint
Q - Dash
F - Block
R - Heavy Hit
Some attacks are holdable.

CURRENT CODES:
Group (must be in group and like the game) , LATEXMAS,HAPPYNEWYEARS,NEEDCASH,NEEDMOREEE,FREERAIDTICKETZ

Premium users gain 1.2X XP, VIP gain a extra 1.2X
Max Level: 240

🎉UPDATES COMING🎉
The game is still in its early stages! Expect bugs and changes.

AFK Chamber gives great rewards! Raids and other things can be found around the map.
